reviews.review:
Ok so here's the thing, I completed the boiler section, and had to go across the map to the office, then go across the map again to do another thing and start the next section of the game. . . I died. . . I was sent back to the boiler again! WHY!?! Why couldn't I just respawn at the office? It's not hard to get back but it's just tedious. The game isn't that bad but the bugs are crazy. The game kept me on edge and they nailed the horror right, but the checkpoints are just straight up annoying. Once they fix all of these issues, then I'll consider playing again, but for now, I can't recommend this game to anyone. It has potential and I do want this game to succeed. But having to walk all the way back is insane.

ALSO! There are manual save stations? which the game for some reason never decided to tell me in any way. So when you update the game can you tell the player that they exist?
reviews.developer_response: We are working on fixing the reported bugs as they come through to us and will be pushing regular updates, but on the issue of the saves, Huntsman is designed to be a challenging survival horror experience. As such, there are few autosave points and players need to use the manual save stations regularly if they choose.
